messages:
mia: Kicking off a controlled deploy to gateway service  — canary to 5% then 25% at +20m. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Runbook link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/gateway-deploy-failsafe :eyes:
deploy-bot: [automated] canary job created for gateway v3.12.0 -> 5% traffic. Monitoring hooks attached. Logs: /deploy/logs/3950012345
sam: Quick q — what's the exact abort criteria? latency p95 > 250ms or error rate > 1%?
mia: Yes, primary aborts are p95 > 250ms sustained for 3m or 1% 5m error rate. Secondary is increased tail-image-fail alerts (S3 5xx). See runbook appendix A.
lee: Adding ops note: if we hit the abort, do NOT immediately pin global traffic to old canary; use the traffic-split rollback flow. Steps in runbook: 1) pause rollout, 2) pin old variant, 3) scale old pods, 4) invalidate caches. Link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/backout-gateway-v3
olivia: Pasting quick escape commands for convenience:
```
# pause canary
rcctl rollout pause gateway --id=3950012345
# abort and pin to previous stable
rcctl rollout abort gateway --id=3950012345 --pin=stable-3.11.8
```
ops-runbooks-bot: Reference checklist updated in runbook: added cache invalidation command and network drain note (updated 2026-02-17).
sam: Thanks. Who is on watch for canary metrics next 30m?
mia: I'm on it until +30. Lee will take +30–+60. Olivia will watch logs/trace. Ping @oncall if anything funky.
deploy-bot: [status] canary reached 5% at +02m. No errors above threshold.
mia: FYI, we've enabled KV prefix caching in this rollout to reduce cold-token spikes — if we need to backout, clearing the cache is required after pin. Command in runbook.
lee: Note about DB migrations: this deploy includes a non-destructive background migration. If we abort, migration consumer will stop, but a tiny delay before rollback is expected. See migration section in runbook.
sam: If we need to roll forward faster, what's the safe fast-path?
mia: Fast-path: 1) confirm canary metrics stable for 10m, 2) increase to 25% via `rcctl rollout set-split 25`, 3) watch for 5m. We avoid pushing to 100% until after 30m steady.
deploy-bot: [alert] 3950012345 — at +18m p95=238ms, errors=0.7% — within thresholds.
olivia: Copy. I also uploaded a short checklist to PR: https://go.redwood/pr/9876 — contains a single-line rollback summary for on-call.
lee: If we hit the abort, ops should call the postmortem owner in runbook header (oncall rotation). Communication play: post immediate status to #incidents and file short-incident note in ops-docs.
mia: Thanks team — I'll update the runbook link with the exact cache-clear command in appendix now. :thumbsup:
